_notes.if: permission-rule syntax — Write(*.py) matches by filename suffix; Write(**/*.py) does NOT
_notes.SessionStart: suggest-agents.py reads project cwd from stdin JSON, suggests relevant installed agents
_notes.windows_path_gotcha: /d/ as a command ARG is auto-translated by Git Bash; /d/ hardcoded inside python code is NOT — use __file__-relative paths
_notes.quoting: script paths are double-quoted: {{ECOSYSTEM_ROOT}} expands to this clone's real path, which on Windows routinely contains a space because the home directory carries the user's full name. Unquoted, the shell splits the path at that space and the hook silently never runs — including the secret guard.
